method: Site choices with no source in the reviewed files were matched on 2.1.2.0 files: the capture raw folder overlaid with reports/mp-copies-2026-11-10/raw (multiplayer copies read last). Each row names the attachment record, its progression and unlock selectors (asset and GUID) and the AAM record whose in-game name resolves the site name. Rubberized Vertical is Attachment_*_BTM_DDVertical (AAM 'DD Vertical', string EEEBB4DD). The NSW4 (Devgru) files have no separate multiplayer copy and are not in campaign-only.txt. Where two attachments carry the same in-game name (NSW4 Alloy Vertical: Zenitco RK1 and RK2) both are listed, as for BREN3 and M27IAR. The six magazines with no name match (M60 75 Rnd and 100 Fast, M250 75 Rnd, M240L 75 Fast, M87A1 and M1014 8 Rnd) were confirmed from stored capacity in the selected WPM package (see storedCheck on each row).
